title: Bervenia Palace skull encounter: solo protagonist vs a five-member enemy clan, Judge present
revision_note: A2.4a (2026-09-10) corrected the roster model after live reads: the fixture holds seven units (five enemy clan members, the neutral Judge, and the player), slot0 is an enemy (Jon), and the player is slot6 with an EWRAM name pointer. Earlier claims that the battle fielded six clan members, that slot6 was a turn-scratch record, or that Marche is slot0, are refuted. See docs/battle-fixtures.md and outputs/autobattle/A2.4a/summary.md.

source.save: Zophar endgame battery save (final-battle chapter, FILE NO. 2)
source.emulator: mGBA 0.10.5 win64 (build 26b7884bc25a5933960f3cdcd98bac1ae14d42e2, Qt, -g GDB stub + Scripting console)
source.port_note: mGBA 0.10.5 has no CLI or config override for the stub port (GDBController::setPort is only reachable from the GDB window UI), so only one guarded instance can run at a time. tools/fixture_guard.py refuses to start when the port already has a listener.

verified_battle_start.note: Primary fixture (A1 capture); live state identical to fix3.

verified_battle_start_run1.note: A1 reproducibility run; same roster, PC in IWRAM rather than the key poll.

savestates.untracked: Savestates are never committed; the ignored outputs/lua-nav directory is the only local store.

battle_roster.count_note: The count covers all seven units including the player; there is no turn-scratch slot inside the array. Only the record past the count is sentinel/empty.

ai_mirror_array.contents: The six AI units (ids 0-5, Marche absent) in a different order with different CT values.
ai_mirror_array.relevance: Sequencer context pointers captured at 0x080C03C2 reference this copy, not the roster array; attribute actors by decoded name.

battle_roster.judge_note: The Judge is present for all seven units; its actions have not been observed.

turn_order.first_observer: Battle start opens with the player's menu (Marche, solo) and WT display 1/7.
turn_order.note: No unit holds CT >= 1000 in the fixture; the fixture is the pre-turn input state, not a mid-charge slice.

reproducibility.method: boot the savestate on a fresh -g instance, halt, guard, then drive DOWN DOWN A A and watch the sequencer seeds
reproducibility.result: identical baseline (PC, CT vector, slot0 id/ea) and identical outcome on both reloads
reproducibility.rng_note: Fixture guarantees state, not RNG stream.

observed_enemy_turn_sequence: player menu open at battle start for the solo protagonist (slot6)
menu route DOWN DOWN A A commits the turn
sequencer seed at 0x080C03C2 with contexts naming Carson / Jon / Schneider
Godfrey and Schneider CT reset to 0 as their turns are consumed
open_questions: Why does a2-battle-start.ss0 not hold the battle roster it was cited for?
Do the five enemy clan units and the Judge all act within one round?
Is the 0x8000 side bit demonstrably the AI-controlled side, by an executed branch rather than by exclusion?
Whether the clan can win this encounter hands-off is A3 scope
